---
title: "Introduction"
---

Images, videos, and links can make course content more engaging and help participants explore a topic in more depth. This module shows how to include these elements in your course pages.

The examples demonstrate how to add media and links using Quarto and Markdown. You can copy the snippets and replace the example URLs, image paths, or descriptions with your own.

## Learning objectives

By the end of this module, you will know how to:

- Add links to external websites and other course pages.
- Insert an image and provide alternative text.
- Embed a video in a content page.
- Use media to support the learning material.

::: {.callout-important}
## Remember accessibility

Provide meaningful alternative text for images, and use descriptive link text so that readers understand where a link leads. For example, use “Read the course guidelines” rather than “Click here”.
:::

## In this module

- **Topic 1 – Links and images:** Examples of linking to resources and adding images to a page.
- **Topic 2 – Embedded videos and media:** How to include video and other media in your course content.
